payload.text: ISSUE 0657 BANKED AND BOOKED (S): refs/bank/cc/0657/v2, blob 7d1f02d89685, patch-id 60b3c7c55ad9. If a bank before it moves, cc re-banks over the new stack. No CHANGELOG hunk. No push, no release.
